    • contentType

      String contentType()

    • charsetOrNull

      @Nullable Charset charsetOrNull()
      The charset the bytes are encoded with, or null if there is no single fixed charset for this content type. Both built-in LogOutput.ContentType.StandardContentType constants are always StandardCharsets.UTF_8 - LogOutput.ContentType.StandardContentType.APPLICATION_JSON by spec, and LogOutput.ContentType.StandardContentType.TEXT_PLAIN because UTF-8 is standard enough on modern Java (e.g. String#getBytes()'s no-charset overload) to treat as the assumed default rather than "unspecified" - an encoder actually configured with a different charset (see LogEncoder.builder(LogFormatter)) reports a different content type instead, not LogOutput.ContentType.StandardContentType.TEXT_PLAIN.
      Returns:
      charset or null if not fixed/known.

    • of

      static LogOutput.ContentType of(String contentType, @Nullable Charset charsetOrNull)
      Finds the matching LogOutput.ContentType.StandardContentType for the given content type and charset if one exists, otherwise creates a new plain LogOutput.ContentType.
      Parameters:
      contentType - content type, e.g. text/plain.
      charsetOrNull - charset or null if not fixed/known.
      Returns:
      a LogOutput.ContentType.StandardContentType if one matches, otherwise a plain LogOutput.ContentType.
